# Crestfall

Crestfall pairs a deep dark canvas with a warm syntax palette of orange keywords, blue functions and green strings, presented in floating glass panels with rounded sidebars and light borders. It adds seven checkbox states, fifteen colored callouts, styled tables and Dataview output, themed Kanban lanes, colored graph nodes, and IBM Plex Mono for code.

![Crestfall screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/code-alchemist-dev/obsidian-crestfall/HEAD/screenshot.png)
